content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required authorization; this payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review, and no claim-data error is identified. Although a medical-necessity appeal was already attempted, the published rules do not establish that appeals are exhausted, and appeals are the only action that produced payment in similar cases (2/8). Another necessity appeal is therefore the best supported recovery path rather than resubmitting unchanged or transferring a contractual denial to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
